definitions.explanation: The edge of a body of water — river, lake, or sea.

examples.japanese: ⟦{湖|みずうみ}→湖：00867_mizuumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{岸辺|きしべ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}った→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: I stood on the shore of the lake.

examples.japanese: {岸辺|きしべ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧⟦ボート→ボート：00018_booto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいた→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Small boats were lined up along the shore.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夕日|ゆうひ}→夕日：04080_yuuhi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{照|て}らされた→照らす：04669_terasu⟧{岸辺|きしべ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{風景|ふうけい}→風景：03591_fuukei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦まるで→まるで：03739_marude⟧⟦{絵|え}→絵：02613_e⟧⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧⟦{美|うつく}しかった→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: The shore lit up by the sunset was as beautiful as a painting.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{岸|きし}→岸：02545_kishi⟧ (shore, bank) + {辺|べ} (vicinity, edge). A somewhat literary word that can refer to the edge of any body of water. Has a poetic, evocative quality and appears frequently in literature and song titles.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{湖|みずうみ}→湖：00867_mizuumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{岸辺|きしべ}: lakeshore
- ⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{岸辺|きしべ}: riverbank
- {岸辺|きしべ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{打|う}ち{寄|よ}せる→打ち寄せる：28677_uchiyoseru⟧⟦{波|なみ}→波：00868_nami⟧: waves lapping at the shore
- {岸辺|きしべ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: to walk along the shore

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{川辺|かわべ}→川辺：20224_kawabe⟧: riverside — specifically for rivers
- ⟦{川岸|かわぎし}→川岸：24545_kawagishi⟧: riverbank — more concrete, the physical bank
- ⟦{海辺|うみべ}→海辺：05498_umibe⟧: seaside — specifically for the ocean
- ⟦{湖畔|こはん}→湖畔：17526_kohan⟧: lakeside — specifically for lakes, often more formal
